title: The Final Broadcast of a Collapsing World — Part 1

series.summary: Inside the barricaded high school faculty lounge, Takashi, Rei, Saya, and the surviving students watch live television in stunned horror. Special news bulletins report that riot police in major metropolitan areas are being overwhelmed by assailants who are already biologically deceased. The broadcast escalates into global catastrophe: the American president flees the White House to an airborne command aircraft, contact with Moscow is completely lost, Beijing burns, and nuclear retaliation protocols are considered. Realizing that civilization has collapsed worldwide, the survivors realize no outside rescue is coming.

segments.voiceover_text: Emergency news broadcasts show riot police opening fire on advancing crowds. The terrified anchor screams the unthinkable truth on air: the attackers are already dead.
Studio broadcasters urge families to remain indoors. But television monitors behind the desk reveal cities engulfed in smoke as public order disintegrates.
In the faculty lounge, Takashi and Saya watch the screen in shock. Saya bitterly points out that government attempts to contain panic have failed completely.
Worldwide reports confirm world leaders are fleeing to airborne bunkers as global capitals fall dark. Trapped inside the school, can six students survive a fallen world?
